import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
/**
 * 限时活动 - 商店浏览
 * 指令：/活动商店 付费|任务|限时
 */
import App from '@src/response-apps/limitedEvent/shop/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { EVENT_FOOTER, EVENT_HEADER } from '@src/response/limitedEvent/nav';
import { addOptions, FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';
/** 商店类型文字映射 */
const SHOP_TYPE_MAP: Record<string, number> = {
  商店: 1,
  任务: 2,
  特惠: 3
};

/** 商店类型 → 标题 */
const SHOP_TITLE_MAP: Record<string, string> = {
  商店: '活动商店',
  任务: '任务商店',
  特惠: '特惠商店'
};

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const uid = e.uid as number;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const md = Format.createMarkdown();

  const text = (e.MessageText ?? '').trim();
  const match = text.match(/限时活动\s+(商店|任务|特惠)/);
  const shopTypeKey = match?.[1] ?? '商店';
  const shopType = SHOP_TYPE_MAP[shopTypeKey] ?? 1;
  const shopTitle = SHOP_TITLE_MAP[shopTypeKey] ?? '活动商店';

  const result = await App({ uid, shopType, bid });

  if (result.code === 'LOAD_FAILED') {
    md.addText(result.data.message);

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: shopTitle, header: EVENT_HEADER, content: md }));

    return;
  }

  const shopList = result.data.shopList;

  if (!shopList.length) {
    md.addText('当前没有可购买的活动商品');

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: shopTitle, header: EVENT_HEADER, content: md }));

    return;
  }

  for (const shop of shopList) {
    md.addText(`${shop.eventTitle} - ${shop.shopName}`);
    md.addNewline();

    for (const p of shop.products) {
      const limitText = p.limitPerUser > 0 ? `限购${p.userBought}/${p.limitPerUser}` : '♾️';
      const stockText = p.stockRemain >= 0 ? `库存${p.stockRemain}` : '';
      const infoText = [limitText, stockText].filter(Boolean).join('、');
      const rewardText = p.rewardTextParts.filter(Boolean).join('、');
      const titleText = rewardText.length > 0 ? rewardText.replaceAll('×', ' X') : p.productName;

      md.addBlockquote(
        addOptions(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`【${p.productId}】${titleText}`), [
          { label: '购买', command: `/活动购买 ${p.productId}` },
          ...p.detailCommands.slice(0, 3).map((item, index) => ({
            label: p.detailCommands.length === 1 ? '详情' : `详${index + 1}`,
            command: item.command
          }))
        ])
      );

      md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`价格：${p.priceTypeName}×${p.priceAmount}、${infoText}`));
    }

    md.addNewline();
  }

  void message.send(
    FormatGui({
      isPrivate,
      bid,
      title: shopTitle,
      header: EVENT_HEADER,
      content: md,
      footer: EVENT_FOOTER
    })
  );
});
